limitations: A valid Compose configuration would not prove application or data equivalence.
Compose bridge networking does not reproduce ECS awsvpc, IAM, scaling or load balancing.
Database data migration, rollback and cutover are not implemented.
No data or secrets are transferred. Generated files must be reviewed before running Docker Compose.
No host ports are published; container ports are only exposed within the Compose network.
PostgreSQL image uses the source major version only; verify patch version, extensions and settings before use.
S3 objects, version history, IAM and policies are not migrated or mapped.
